ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Kierkegaard & Company: Existentialism, Pietism and The Discovery of Self Beginning with philosophical questions posed by Sren Kierkegaard in the early 1800s, this course traces themes of existentialism, pietism, individualism and modern notions of "self" as they evolved in Scandinavian literature. Includes works by Fredrika Bremer, H.C. Andersen, August Strindberg, Henrik Ibsen, Karen Blixen, and Ingmar Bergman. Meets with SCAN 496 and PHIL 444. Classes held in English. Section restricted to Undergrad.
